newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos, fx forwards inch down in listless trad.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos, fx forwards inch down in listless trad.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were hovering around morning levels but for a downward bias in late unexciting trade with the central bank injecting overnight cash at 13.40 percent, dealers said.
"It was very quiet today with depos and forex forwards inching lower in late dull trade,"said a dealer at a foreign banks. "I think we will see more of the same tomorrow."
Dealers said the market was awaiting for an official statement on the issue of retroactive taxation of FRNs and derivatives.

High-level officials at the national economy ministry who wanted to keep their anonymity insisted that there would be no retroactive taxation of FRNs but made no commitment for a withholding tax on derivatives.
The mark was quoted at 157.80/85 drachmas from Thursday's 157.885 fix, the dollar at 238.01/11 drachmas from 238.000 and the Ecu at 302.15/25 from 302.150 drachmas.
